name: AthleteWellnessReadinessMonitor
tagline: Daily wellness check-ins, baseline-relative readiness flags and a staff review workflow for performance departments.
description: A complete Power Platform app in one PCF control: athletes answer five 1–5 wellness questions plus sleep, resting heart rate and pain; the app scores readiness, compares every answer with the athlete's own rolling baseline, raises red/amber flags, chases missing check-ins and gives staff a follow-up board with enforced review rules. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box. Not a medical device.
features: Own rolling baseline with z-score flags
Absolute thresholds while a baseline builds
Compliance and missing check-ins with reminders
Heat map with 8 metrics over 7/14/28 days
Review workflow with action and availability rules
Bulk clear green and bulk follow-up
Live readiness preview in the check-in form
Demo mode with a fictional squad
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
